usedFor: Billing events in Spaceinvoices, such as “Order Updated”, write text into a Google Docs tab.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Updated” in Spaceinvoices, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: When an order changes, the action writes the update into a chosen doc tab, so the document tracks billing.

watchOut: “Unit Deleted” and “Item Deleted” fire on removals, so check the doc tab should record those too.
